entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A black body at the 1,235 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Kammer et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table)): #ff5300. Chosen from the archive's emission rows by rule: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength. Reflected starlight is not included.
